solutions.title: Count then relink
solutions.strategy: Count each value first, then relink only nodes whose value count is one.

timeComplexity.explanation: The list is scanned once for counts and once for relinking.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The count map stores one entry per distinct value.

solutions.title: Sentinel run skip
solutions.strategy: Use one pass with a sentinel and skip every run whose length is greater than one.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is visited as part of exactly one sorted run.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only pointer references are used beyond the list itself.
